description: This Java class defines an Observable object for implementing the observer pattern with improved concurrency features, preventing subclassing, and exposing protected methods publicly.

classes.name: Observable
classes.description: A thread-safe, final class implementing the observable pattern, allowing observers to register, deregister, and be notified of changes.

methods.name: addObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the set of observers for this object.

methods.name: deleteObserver
methods.description: Removes a specific observer from the observer list.

methods.name: deleteObservers
methods.description: Removes all observers from the observer list.

methods.name: hasChanged
methods.description: Checks if the observable has been marked as changed.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies all registered observers, passing null as the argument.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies all registered observers, passing a specified argument.
